Haven, built from the commit this release points at.

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `Haven-Android.apk` | Android 8 and later. Open it on the phone and allow the install. |
| `Haven-iOS-unsigned.ipa` | iPhone and iPad, iOS 16 and later. Install with AltStore, SideStore or Sideloadly, which sign it with your Apple ID. |
| `Haven-WebApp.zip` | The web app, to host anywhere. |
| `altstore-source.json` | Add this address in AltStore to get updates. |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums of the files above. |

Update every phone and tablet you use Haven on. Since 1.5.1, versions before it can open your haven but not save it: an older version signing in on a new device could reset the account's coins to 0.

On an iPhone the quickest way is the web app: open https://shira421.github.io/haven/ in Safari, then Share, then Add to Home Screen.
